verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs say it pulls in help center content and wiki-style sources (Zendesk, Confluence, Notion) without re-authoring. It also syncs websites and creates content import sources from a URL, which covers external docs. Nothing in the pack shows past tickets or conversations being ingested as a knowledge source. Missing for 10: evidence of ingesting past tickets/conversation history as knowledge, in-depth docs on sync behavior and connector scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the agent ingests my help center, docs, past tickets, and internal wikis as knowledge sources without manual re-authoring

citations.quote: Bring content from your help center, Zendesk, Confluence, Notion, and more into one place, so Fin, Copilot, and your team always work from the same source of truth.
Train Fin on your knowledge, data, policies, and tone of voice.
